metaDescription: Order custom full color outdoor products for your brand. Durable, vibrant designs from Perfect Imprints. Request a quote today!
introHtml: Full color decoration brings your brand's logo or design to life with vivid, photographic-quality detail on outdoor products. Whether you're outfitting a company picnic with custom blankets or creating giveaways for a trade show, full color printing captures gradients, textures, and fine text that spot colors cannot. The Roll-Up Fleece Blanket and Ultimate Travel Companion both accept full color decoration, making them ideal for promotions that need to stand out at outdoor events, parks, or sporting venues.
heroAltText: Custom full color outdoor products like a roll-up fleece blanket with vibrant full-color logo
